inputs.text: Taylor shutting down Hastie’s challenge isn’t just political theatre—it’s a way to keep attention on personalities while the interests behind gas-company taxes and property-investor concessions stay protected. The same silence around Trump and the US and Israel’s war with Iran serves those powerful allies. Calling it neutrality gives the public a tidy explanation; the real effect is to keep consequential choices out of scrutiny.
